mechanism: Lock one small, materially specific anchor and one visible trigger in a stable composition. Expand fragments of that same material through several readable scale levels until they form a complete world, while retaining at least one origin cue. Hold the maximum scale, then reverse the same material lineage and camera axis until the original anchor, trigger relationship and surrounding surface are restored for an exact visual loop.

invariants.rule: Establish one compact material anchor, surrounding surface and visible trigger before expansion.
invariants.purpose: Defines an exact state to recover.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic glow has no material history.

invariants.rule: Let fragments of the anchor visibly generate the first larger structure.
invariants.purpose: Binds scale change to one material family.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hard cut to a new world breaks causality.

invariants.rule: Expand through at least two readable scale levels while retaining an origin cue.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate maximum scale feels like an unrelated reveal.

invariants.rule: Hold one complete maximum-scale world before contraction begins.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clear apex and reversal threshold.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous blur hides whether expansion completed.

invariants.rule: Reverse the same lineage and optical axis to restore the original anchor and trigger relationship.
invariants.ablation_failure: Returning to a similar but different object is only a thematic echo.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source mixed chili and seed spice pile
the source adult fingers pinching the pile
the source orange-blue galaxy and planet arrangement
the source Yapper watermark and exact spice-cosmos-spice composition

instantiations.concept: On an original dark theatre floor, one compact knot of white wool rests beneath a brass tuning fork. A single vibration loosens fibers into a cloud bank, expands into a room-scale weather front and mountain atmosphere, then reverses through cloud and fiber until the identical wool knot sits under the same fork.
